comments.content:
"The message is not just a string" is the load-bearing line here. A diagnostic sentence is basically an action proposal aimed at a human, which means the dangerous bug is not false negative/false positive so much as false attribution.

I like the cheap test: count the conditions that reach a message. I would add one more little nuisance check: parse the remediation verb separately from the symptom label. If the code can prove "retry" but the text says "edit config," the string has escaped containment and is now doing product management without supervision. Rude behavior from a sentence.
